build.label: Current public Windows diagnostic playtest on GitHub
build.tested: Four managed assemblies, corrected import audit and 63 scoped native cases passed. Exact package/extraction, anonymous public GitHub download/hash, Solo and complete same-PC headless two-process no-purchase Zombie baseline passed. Menu, restart, human/controller/Deck, separate-PC, six-role/Horde/full-purchase and sustained 30 FPS remain open.
build.sourceLabel: Exact package source manifest 198DC281 is recorded separately from the later verified source commit. Visual05 and older downloads remain archived with their original evidence. Custom-domain HTTPS delivery is unverified.
manifest: Normal campaign and finite-round Zombie mode; Hunter is the current playable class
Campfire and existing devil-elk artwork updates, backed by scoped import/native validation
F2 Friends; Tab/F3 camp board; every peer needs this exact ZIP and protocol 61 / save 24
Build-specific isolated saves; prior saves and existing audio behavior preserved
Windows diagnostic playtest; full visual/human/hardware/performance and separate-PC acceptance remain open

evidence.title: Assets34 public diagnostic release and exact package

stages.title: Protect the hunt
stages.summary: Current bugs, audio and RPG performance.
criteria: Fix reported defects and audio issues with repeatable playtest evidence
Optimize lag without nerfing 1d79ef7 perk stacking, projectiles, damage or ammo
First-person remains primary; third-person supports character inspection
Compass and clearer upgrade navigation pass usability review
stages.blocker: Assets34 is the current GitHub public diagnostic playtest. Its exact package passed Solo and the complete same-PC headless two-process no-purchase Zombie baseline. Interactive menus, no-argument startup, process-restart persistence, sustained 30 FPS, human usability/listening and supported-hardware acceptance remain open.

stages.title: Three worlds. One identity.
stages.summary: All-biome asset polish, with the strongest pass reserved for the fire finale.
criteria: Forest, snow and fire assets pass visual and performance review
Natural terrain and forage feel coherent
Polar bear and snow tracks verified in play
Rare Christmas trees and late-snow red-nosed reindeer encounter verified
20+ live elk lead to Santa boss, present and camp outfit unlock
stages.blocker: Campfire artwork and the existing devil-elk encounter model are integrated in Assets34 source. The additional library passed its import audit, and all 13 library sheets / 196 tiles plus 6 boss and 6 camp originals were reviewed. Boss side/warning views and mid/far camp views remain partly obscured. Full visual fit, readable warnings/approaches, animation, multiplayer and performance acceptance remain open; the exact Assets34 package passed scoped Solo and local Zombie diagnostics, with broader acceptance still open.

stages.title: Survive what follows
stages.summary: Normal/Zombie and Hunter systems are in the Assets34 public diagnostic build. Broader survival, progression, bosses and full purchase acceptance remain unfinished.
criteria: Normal Forest / Snow / Fire progression and independent endless Zombie runs preserve unlocks, host authority and saves; Start New never overwrites an existing slot
Main-menu Zombie Mode includes all species and unrestricted-distance pursuit
Fire undead-elk boss passes gameplay and balance review
Special signature weapons roll independently at 33% per kill; no third-kill guarantee
Destruction, NPC quests and progression pass complete-loop tests
Normal mode’s nuke ending is realistic and entirely in-scene, with no AI video. Endless Zombie has no win, nuke or finale.
stages.blocker: The current Assets34 same-PC headless two-process no-purchase baseline passed real kills, round/save, camp and grenade checks. This is not interactive menu, process-restart or full gameplay acceptance. Archived Visual05 failed its complete cooperative diagnostic; historical Horde/full-purchase failures remain separate and open.

stages.title: Bring the whole party
stages.summary: Steam Deck is the current hardware priority. Six players remains the default; separate-PC and hardware validation are still open.
criteria: Six players complete a synchronized full session
Defined supported hardware/settings sustain minimum 30 FPS; 60 FPS preferred
Steam Deck controls, readability and performance measured
Performance improvements preserve gameplay semantics
stages.blocker: Windows desktop and local multi-process results are not Steam Deck or separate-PC proof. A historical six-role clock baseline had 11.93 common seconds at low density. A later 1,024 attempt failed during setup, so it did not establish ordinary-AI capacity. Six remains the default; four-versus-six and fewer/faster enemies are private comparisons.

stages.title: Earn the release
stages.summary: Steamworks onboarding, store and build review, then release.
criteria: Onboarding, app identity and app-fee payment date verified privately
First-title 21-day fee clock and 14-day public Coming Soon requirement satisfied
Store/pricing/content survey approved, then playable build approved
Purchase, install and launch smoke tests pass
Dashboard confirms seasonal discount eligibility and saved discount
stages.blocker: All account and approval gates remain unverified. Sale participation is not guaranteed.

decisions.title: In-scene finale
decisions.text: The old 30-45 second video requirement is cancelled. Normal mode’s nuclear ending must be realistic and rendered entirely in the game scene. Endless Zombie has no win, nuke or finale.

decisions.title: Preserve RPG behavior
decisions.text: Optimization must preserve the current 1d79ef7 perk stacking, projectile, damage and ammo semantics.

decisions.title: Independent loot rolls
decisions.text: Signature weapon drops use an independent 33% chance per kill, with no guaranteed third drop.

targets: Planned release-candidate acceptance and build-review submission
